BJP Rejigs State In-Charges Ahead of Polls

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has reshuffled 36 state in-charges and co-in-charges. Ram Madhav has been appointed as the in-charge for Uttarakhand, and Smriti Irani has been assigned to Haryana. Several other leaders have been assigned to poll-bound states.
